title: How LLM Inference Works (8 minute read)

ai_summary: LLM 추론 파이프라인의 토크나이징, 임베딩, 셀프-어텐션 레이어 과정을 설명합니다. 추론 과정을 컴퓨팅 집약적 프리필과 메모리 집약적 디코드 두 단계로 나눕니다.

title: You Are Not Immune To Mode Collapse (8 minute read)
summary: Mode collapse occurs when models repeatedly generate the most common outputs, leading to homogenous results, exemplified by AI generating more dogs over cats with unbalanced training data. It similarly impacts various domains like grant-making and music, as systems become increasingly specialized over time based on prior outputs and successes. To counteract, introduce variability or change external pressures to diversify and prevent over-specialization.
